milestones.title: Phase 0: Stabilization MVP
milestones.description: QA checklist, bug fixes, README, EAS preview, legal i18n. Target: internal alpha.

milestones.title: Phase 1: Backend integration
milestones.description: Staging API, auth/sync E2E, backup recovery key, AI scan, API integration tests. Target: closed beta.

milestones.title: Phase 2: Quality & Security
milestones.description: Maestro E2E, mobile unit tests, Sentry, analytics, security audit, performance. Target: release candidate.

milestones.title: Phase 3: Compliance & Store
milestones.description: EAS production certs, store metadata, GDPR/152-ФЗ, soft launch, production API.

milestones.title: Phase 4: v1.0 Launch
milestones.description: Production feature flags, Go/No-Go checklist, public App Store + Google Play release.

milestones.title: Phase 5: Post-launch
milestones.description: v1.1+ backlog: OCR menu, push reminders, More tab, live map, marketplace, scaling.

issues.title: [P1.2] Backend auth E2E
issues.body:
## Описание
Сквозной flow: register → login → создание/чтение профилей на сервере с `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_AUTH=true`.

## Критерий готовности
- [ ] Регистрация создаёт пользователя на сервере
- [ ] Login возвращает JWT, сессия сохраняется на клиенте
- [ ] Профили синхронизируются с сервером после auth

## Открытый вопрос
Dual-write (local + server) vs server-authoritative после login.

## Связанные документы
- [Roadmap to Production](../docs/roadmap-to-prod.md#phase-1--backend-integration--closed-beta)
